description.en: Trailing 12-month revenue (USD billions) combines the last full year (185.019) with this year's reported year-to-date revenue (141.665) less the matching prior-year period (139.732).
description.zh: 最近十二个月营收以十亿 USD 计：上个完整财年 185.019，加本财年累计 141.665，减去上年同期累计 139.732。

description.en: The model holds the latest reported standalone quarter’s diluted weighted-average share count constant.
description.zh: 模型固定采用本季已披露的加权平均摊薄股数。

label.en: SEC company facts · financial and share disclosures
label.zh: SEC 公司财务数据：财务和股数披露

method_note.en: Growth, normalized net margin and forward P/E are research assumptions. Multiples reflect the expected persistence of earnings and company-specific risk. The denominator is held constant across scenarios.
method_note.zh: 增长、常态净利率和远期市盈率均为研究假设。倍数反映对盈利持续性和公司特有风险的判断。三个情景使用相同股数。

rationale.en: Pricing, financing losses and incentives pressure consolidated earnings.
rationale.zh: 定价、融资业务损失与销售激励压缩合并盈利。

rationale.en: Truck mix and cost execution preserve mid-cycle earnings.
rationale.zh: 卡车销售组合与成本控制维持周期中段盈利。

rationale.en: Incentives ease and both automotive and financing results improve.
rationale.zh: 销售激励减少，汽车与金融业务盈利改善。
